steps.en: OCMS receives the court's update for a court fine paid to State Courts
steps.id: OCMS menerima update pengadilan untuk denda yang dibayar ke State Courts
steps.why_en: No receiver exists for court decisions about fines paid to State Courts.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penerima keputusan pengadilan untuk denda yang dibayar ke State Courts.

steps.en: OCMS looks up the court settlement record for the notice
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa catatan penyelesaian di pengadilan untuk notice itu
steps.why_en: No court settlement record exists to look up.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada catatan penyelesaian pengadilan yang bisa diperiksa.

steps.en: OCMS looks up the warrant of commitment record
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa catatan surat perintah penahanan (warrant of commitment)
steps.why_en: No warrant of commitment record exists to look up.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada catatan warrant of commitment yang bisa diperiksa.

steps.en: OCMS looks up the instalment plan record
steps.why_en: No instalment plan record exists to look up.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada catatan rencana cicilan yang bisa diperiksa.

steps.en: The conditions are matched against a fixed rule matrix
steps.id: Kondisi dicocokkan dengan matriks aturan yang sudah ditetapkan
steps.why_en: There is no rule matrix; the suspension type is taken as sent by another system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada matriks aturan; jenis suspension diambil apa adanya dari sistem lain.

steps.en: A permanent suspension type is set on the court fine notice
steps.id: Jenis permanent suspension dipasang pada notice denda pengadilan
steps.why_en: A suspension type can be set, but only as sent by another system, with no check against rules.
steps.why_id: Jenis suspension bisa dipasang, tetapi hanya sesuai kiriman sistem lain, tanpa dicek terhadap aturan.
